pages.text: Mod allows you to apply '$(6)Silk Touch$()' and '$(6)Channeling$()' on vanilla shears.$(br2)Thanks to the first enchant, you can change the vanilla leaves into mod and vice versa.$(br2)Additionally, with the second enchant you$(br)
$(br)can extract $(2)Ender Eye$() from vanilla and mod $(l:additional/end_portal_frame)End Portal Frame$() which will disable the portal.$(br)
